bindings.meaning: id identifies the application entity. Departmental assignment determines queue access; the service owning department alone does not prove queue membership. On this licensing applications page, license request / licensing request / طلبات الترخيص denotes the application entity identified by id. These are page-scoped language aliases, not licence entities or workflow tasks; they do not alter the selected queue or any status definition.

Application grain is id. Distinct application counts can differ from projected workflow/disposition rows. On this licensing applications page, license request / licensing request / طلبات الترخيص denotes the application entity identified by id. These are page-scoped language aliases, not licence entities or workflow tasks; they do not alter the selected queue or any status definition.
The task represented by a current queue row. The server projection has already selected representative tasks; this is not every historical workflow task.
Task grain uses a nonempty taskId. Distinct visible projected tasks are different from distinct applications and from all historical workflow tasks.
status is the current application/process status label; statusId is its numeric code. It is distinct from workflow node taskStatus and the statusCount card taxonomy.
serviceCategoryNameEn is the localized service category display, not an authorization scope.
assignee is the current workflow handler user key. assignedTo is a display name, not a stable unique grouping key.
Personal scope: tasks come from the authenticated user task list, filtered by the endpoint runtime approval department. This exact request context has no user-entered narrowing filter.

Pending population means the complete To Do queue from this operation with this exact filter context. It includes pending modification and external approval as well as pending review; it is not only Pending Review.
The upstream personal task query is bound to the authenticated user. The exact request context and current permission must be verified; no literal user ID is stored in knowledge.
The To Do operation establishes queue membership; there is no generic row status literal Pending that replaces all pending workflow states.
taskStatus is the workflow node status in To Do responses. It is independent from application status.

sourceBinding.scope: authenticated personal queue; current runtime approval department

pagination.pageIndex: Request integer page number, starts at 1; Skip((pageIndex-1)*pageSize).
pagination.pageSize: Request integer maximum rows per page; UI default 10, choices 10/20/50/100. This is not a proven server maximum.
pagination.total: page.total counts rows of the selected view AFTER filters and BEFORE pagination. It is not necessarily distinct application count.
pagination.preservedContext: Keep all filters, identity, language and sort context fixed across pages; two agreeing scans are not a transactional snapshot.

requestFields.keyword: Case-insensitive substring of applicationNumber, serviceNameAr/serviceNameEn and applyForAr/applyForEn; not an exact unique lookup.
requestFields.serviceTypeId: String 1 is ALL SERVICE TYPES, not a Licensing department or Foreign Media selector. A different nonempty value filters serviceTypeId exactly.
requestFields.approvalStatus: To Do matches taskStatus; Completed matches myDecision.
requestFields.serviceCodes: Filter by stable service codes, not one service version ID.
requestFields.endTime: lastUpdatedTime < endTime.Date.AddDays(1). Source server time interpretation needs deployed verification.

fields.id: Application entity key; not a workflow task key.
fields.applicationNumber: Displayed application business number; no global uniqueness constraint was established from the inspected snapshot.
fields.taskId: Workflow task identifier and task detail route parameter. A single application can have multiple task IDs over time.
fields.dispositionCaseId: Nullable disposition identifier; the personal To Do projection deduplicates (id, dispositionCaseId). A nullable component cannot be silently dropped from a task-row identity.
fields.status: Application/process status display; group this field when the requested dimension is application status.
fields.taskStatus: To Do: workflow node; personal Completed: compatibility projection of myDecision.
fields.myDecision: Completed reviewer decision; a dash is not a workflow state.
fields.serviceCode: Stable service code shared by service versions.
fields.serviceNameEn: Service display; may be localized by response language.
fields.serviceCategoryNameEn: Service category display; may be localized.
fields.serviceTypeNameEn: Service type display; may be localized.
fields.applyForEn: Apply For display value; not the handler.
fields.lastUpdatedTime: Latest application timeline/update timestamp. Request startTime/endTime filter this field, even where a control label says Submission Time.
fields.sla: SLA value with business pause/state handling; use current supplied slaDescription rather than inventing clock calculations.
fields.slaDescription: Localized SLA display produced by the service; not a priority category.

relationships: To Do selects noncompleted canonical-instance rows and deduplicates by (id, dispositionCaseId). Completed deduplicates by id.
statusCount is computed before list filters; page.total is computed after filters. Card buckets are not the row status dimension or a proven mutually exclusive breakdown.
A Manager role does not turn this personal queue into a team queue.
constraints: Source-inspected definitions; the remote deployed build has not been matched to this snapshot. Validate current authorized response shape and request context before using these definitions.
This page knowledge does not authorize API access or business writes. A blocked or failed response is not an empty population.
A bounded page is not a complete population. Counts and grouping require complete collection at the requested entity grain and stable request context.
Do not equate row count or todoCount with unique application count when duplicate id values or conflicting projected fields exist.
Scope/population context bindings cover only their exact contextParameters. Omitted defaults, nulls, empty strings and added filters are not interchangeable.
The list has no demonstrated generic priority field. SLA, urgency and priority are separate concepts.
Foreign Media classification must use an authoritative service/category mapping and current permission; serviceTypeId=1 does not establish it.
